$comment: Player equipment. Cooldowns and lifetimes are in milliseconds and are the only place those numbers live. The slick trails behind the car; the smoke cloud hangs between the car and the pursuit.

weapons.label: MACHINE GUN
weapons.description: Twin forward guns. The only weapon that works at range.

weapons.label: OIL SLICK
weapons.description: Drops a slick behind the car. Pursuers that hit it lose control.

weapons.label: SMOKE SCREEN
weapons.description: Blocks pursuit vision. Hostiles behind the cloud stop firing.
